_source: HyperEVM mainnet (chain 999) run of the HyperCore HIP-3 flow, 2026-09-28: 11 creates, the market 47 -> 54 migration and one long plus one short xyz:NVDA cycle; every tx signed by the same EOA, nonces 56-102, all status 1. Inputs are the on-chain calldata; creates carry keccak(init code) only. The run used market id 54; HyperCore has since been renumbered to 55 (54 is the crosschain market), so market_id here is the historical value.
